008package paint.viewer.ui.panels;
009
010import javax.swing.*;
011import java.awt.*;
012
013/**
014 * A user interface panel containing interactive controls for managing recordings
015 * and grid visualization settings within the PAINT viewer.
016 */
017public class RecordingControlsPanel {
018
019    /**
020     * Defines callback methods for handling user actions triggered
021     * by buttons or toggle components on this panel.
022     */
023    public interface RecordingsControlListener {
024        void onFilterRequested();                                             // Called when the user requests to filter the recording list
025        void onSelectSquaresRequested();                                      // Called when the user opens the square-selection dialog
026        void onAssignCellsRequested();                                        // Called when the user opens the cell-assignment dialog
027        void onPlayRecordingRequested();                                      // Called when the user requests to play the current recording
028        void onExportLeftImageRequested();                                    // Called when the user requests to export the left grid image
029        void onShowSquaresRequested();                                        // Called when the user requests to view the squares CSV
030        void onBordersToggled(boolean showBorders);                           // Triggered when borders are toggled on or off
031        void onShadingToggled(boolean showShading);                           // Triggered when shading is toggled on or off
032        void onNumberModeChanged(SquareGridPanel.NumberMode mode);            // Called when the numeric display mode (None, Label, Square) is changed
033        void onExcludeToggleRequested();                                      // Called when the Exclude/Include button is pressed
034    }
035
036    private final JPanel  root;
037    private final JButton filterRecordingsButton;
038    private final JButton selectSquaresButton;
039    private final JButton assignCellsButton;
040    private final JButton playRecordingButton;
041    private final JButton exportImageButton;
042    private final JButton showSquaresButton;
043    private final JButton excludeButton;
044
045    /**
046     * Constructs a {@code RecordingControlsPanel} containing action buttons,
047     * visualization toggles, and numbering mode options. All actions are
048     * delegated to the provided {@link RecordingsControlListener}.
049     *
050     * @param recordingsControlListener the recordingsControlListener that receives callbacks when user actions occur
051     */
052    public RecordingControlsPanel(final RecordingsControlListener recordingsControlListener) {
053
054        root = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
055        root.setBorder(BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
056                BorderFactory.createLineBorder(Color.DARK_GRAY, 2),
057                BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(10, 10, 10, 10)
058        ));
059        root.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(240, 0));
060
061        JPanel content = new JPanel();
062        content.setLayout(new BoxLayout(content, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
063
064        // === Action buttons ===
065        filterRecordingsButton = new JButton("Filter Recordings");
066        selectSquaresButton    = new JButton("Select Squares");
067        assignCellsButton      = new JButton("Assign Cells");
068        playRecordingButton    = new JButton("Play Recording");
069        exportImageButton      = new JButton("Export Image");
070        showSquaresButton      = new JButton("Show Squares Data");
071        excludeButton          = new JButton("Exclude Recording");
072
073        for (JButton button : new JButton[]{
074                filterRecordingsButton,
075                selectSquaresButton,
076                assignCellsButton,
077                playRecordingButton,
078                exportImageButton,
079                showSquaresButton,
080                excludeButton
081        }) {
082            button.setAlignmentX(Component.CENTER_ALIGNMENT);
083            button.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, 28));
084        }
085
086        JPanel controls = new JPanel();
087        controls.setLayout(new BoxLayout(controls, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
088        controls.setBorder(BorderFactory.createTitledBorder("Controls"));
089        controls.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
090        controls.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, controls.getPreferredSize().height));
091
092        controls.add(filterRecordingsButton);
093        controls.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
094        controls.add(selectSquaresButton);
095        controls.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
096        controls.add(assignCellsButton);
097        controls.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
098        controls.add(playRecordingButton);
099        controls.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
100        controls.add(exportImageButton);
101        controls.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
102        controls.add(showSquaresButton);
103        controls.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
104        controls.add(excludeButton);
105
106        // === Borders and shading toggles ===
107        JCheckBox showBorders = new JCheckBox("Show borders", true);
108        JCheckBox showShading = new JCheckBox("Show shading", true);
109
110        JPanel borders = new JPanel();
111        borders.setLayout(new BoxLayout(borders, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
112        borders.setBorder(BorderFactory.createTitledBorder("Borders and Shading"));
113        borders.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
114        borders.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, borders.getPreferredSize().height));
115        borders.add(showBorders);
116        borders.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(5));
117        borders.add(showShading);
118
119        // === Number display options ===
120        JRadioButton none   = new JRadioButton("None", true);
121        JRadioButton label  = new JRadioButton("Label");
122        JRadioButton square = new JRadioButton("Square");
123
124        ButtonGroup buttonGroup = new ButtonGroup();
125        buttonGroup.add(none);
126        buttonGroup.add(label);
127        buttonGroup.add(square);
128
129        JPanel numbers = new JPanel();
130        numbers.setLayout(new BoxLayout(numbers, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
131        numbers.setBorder(BorderFactory.createTitledBorder("Numbers"));
132        numbers.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
133        numbers.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, numbers.getPreferredSize().height));
134        numbers.add(none);
135        numbers.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(5));
136        numbers.add(label);
137        numbers.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(5));
138        numbers.add(square);
139
140        // === Action listeners ===
141        filterRecordingsButton.addActionListener(e -> recordingsControlListener.onFilterRequested());
142        selectSquaresButton.addActionListener(   e -> recordingsControlListener.onSelectSquaresRequested());
143        assignCellsButton.addActionListener(     e -> recordingsControlListener.onAssignCellsRequested());
144        playRecordingButton.addActionListener(   e -> recordingsControlListener.onPlayRecordingRequested());
145        exportImageButton.addActionListener(     e -> recordingsControlListener.onExportLeftImageRequested());
146        showSquaresButton.addActionListener(     e -> recordingsControlListener.onShowSquaresRequested());
147        excludeButton.addActionListener(         e -> recordingsControlListener.onExcludeToggleRequested());
148
149        showBorders.addActionListener(           e -> recordingsControlListener.onBordersToggled(showBorders.isSelected()));
150        showShading.addActionListener(           e -> recordingsControlListener.onShadingToggled(showShading.isSelected()));
151        none.addActionListener(                  e -> recordingsControlListener.onNumberModeChanged(SquareGridPanel.NumberMode.NONE));
152        label.addActionListener(                 e -> recordingsControlListener.onNumberModeChanged(SquareGridPanel.NumberMode.LABEL));
153        square.addActionListener(                e -> recordingsControlListener.onNumberModeChanged(SquareGridPanel.NumberMode.SQUARE));
154
155        // === Layout order ===
156        content.add(controls);
157        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
158        content.add(borders);
159        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
160        content.add(numbers);
161        content.add(Box.createVerticalGlue());
162
163        root.add(content, BorderLayout.NORTH);
164    }
165
166    /**
167     * Returns the root Swing component representing this panel.
168     *
169     * @return the root {@link JComponent}
170     */
171    public JComponent getComponent() {
172        return root;
173    }
174
175    /**
176     * Enables or disables all action buttons on the panel.
177     * <p>
178     * This is used to disable user interaction while modal dialogs
179     * are open or while long-running operations are in progress.
180     *
181     * @param enabled {@code true} to enable all action buttons,
182     *                {@code false} to disable them
183     */
184    public void setButtonsEnabled(boolean enabled) {
185        filterRecordingsButton.setEnabled(enabled);
186        selectSquaresButton.setEnabled(enabled);
187        assignCellsButton.setEnabled(enabled);
188        playRecordingButton.setEnabled(enabled);
189        exportImageButton.setEnabled(enabled);
190        showSquaresButton.setEnabled(enabled);
191        excludeButton.setEnabled(enabled);
192    }
193
194    /**
195     * Updates the text and appearance of the exclusion toggle button
196     * based on the current recording's exclusion status.
197     *
198     * @param excluded {@code true} if the recording is currently excluded,
199     *                 {@code false} otherwise
200     */
201    public void setExcludeButtonText(boolean excluded) {
202        if (excludeButton == null) {
203            return;
204        }
205
206        excludeButton.setText(excluded ? "Include Recording" : "Exclude Recording");
207        Color defaultFg = UIManager.getColor("Button.foreground");
208        if (defaultFg == null) {
209            defaultFg = Color.BLACK;
210        }
211
212        excludeButton.setForeground(excluded ? Color.RED : defaultFg);
213    }
214}
